procedure: Stage A — Static Tilt (at session start, vehicle stationary)
Stage B — GNSS Yaw Calibration (during first reliable motion)

stage_a_tilt.purpose: Estimate roll and pitch of phone relative to horizontal
stage_a_tilt.method: gravity vector from accelerometer during stationary periods
stage_a_tilt.note: In IO-VNBD, pitch ≈ -85°, so gimbal lock applies. The tilt angles (5-10°) are small. Stage B dominates heading accuracy.

stage_b_yaw.method: circular mean of (gnss_course - phone_yaw) during reliable motion
conditions: Use as many samples as available for better estimate
do_not: Do NOT estimate yaw while stationary
Do NOT trust raw magnetometer as sole heading reference
Do NOT use a single GNSS sample

freeze_note: Calibration thresholds set from physics/dataset statistics, not tuned on the 4 held-out test sequences.
